newsitem.title: MEXICO: S&P's gives mxA-1+ rating to Penoles com'l paper.
newsitem.headline: S&P's gives mxA-1+ rating to Penoles com'l paper.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said Wednesday it has assigned a rating of mxA-1+ to the 150 million peso commercial paper program of Industrias Penoles SA.

"The rating reflects the position of Penoles as the biggest producer in the world of refined silver, bismuth and sodium sulfate, and the biggest national (Mexico) producer of gold, lead, refined zinc and magnesium oxide, with a cost structure that places it in the top quarter of low-cost world scale producers," S&P's said in a statement.

"The qualification takes into account the healthy financial profile of the company, which permits it to counteract adverse effects of the cyclical nature of the industry and volatility of metal prices," the rating agency said.
